action_change_recommendation: Decompose AND-of-two-gates: ship Carleson OOD R@1>5% as standalone milestone first (higher base rate via Graph2Tac analogue); treat Mathlib-test R@16>63.5% as the separable stretch bet.
contract_question: Conditional on the v22 design (TypedAST-GNN + dep-DAG online embedding + Lean-verifier-grounded rerank + CoRNStack hard-negative curriculum) passing the CPU validation gate and getting approximately 2 weeks on 3x A6000, will the trained model beat LeanPremise-Large R@16 = 63.5% on Mathlib-test AND lift Carleson OOD R@1 above 5%?
rationale_short: Joint AND is the structural killer: at p~0.45 each marginally the joint sits near 0.20-0.25. Mathlib-test bar is harder because ByT5 at 82M may already implicitly recover binder/type structure that explicit typed-AST duplicates not complements. Carleson OOD is more tractable: dep-DAG online embedding mechanism-matches Graph2Tac (17.4-26.1 unseen-package lift) and verifier-rerank adds orthogonal domain-invariant evidence.
